list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE model != '' UNION ALL SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE model != '') ORDER BY model

list.name: api_key
list.label: Client API Key
list.query: SELECT k AS __text, k AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') AS k FROM llm_gateway.request_log) ORDER BY k

list.name: rejection_mode
list.label: Rejection mode
list.query: binary : binary (per message), instances : instances (weighted, no cap)

panels.title: Overall Score (adherence x reliability, geometric)
panels.description: Score-family (REQ FR-9, revised 2026-09-16): Overall = sqrt(PAI x Reliability) - geometric aggregation (HDI 2010) so no factor can buy back another. PAI (Prompt Adherence Index) = geometric mean of three goalpost-standardized user-side indices (net rejection 0-30%, session abandonment 0-100%: share of sessions containing the model that end on a different model - noisy under multi-model workflows, treat as heuristic, client cancel 0-5%); Reliability = provider-abort index (0-5%). Fixed goalposts, not observed extrema; missing factors count neutral 0.5; models need >=30 requests. Behavioral heuristic, not a quality certification. Friction and speed are reported separately (friction panels, performance dashboard) and deliberately excluded (Tan et al. 2026: speed-quality non-monotone).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sig AS (SELECT model, count() AS reqs, countIf(is_followup = 1) AS fu, countIf(is_followup = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS rej_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1) AS base_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS base_rej FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), spd AS (SELECT model, countIf(is_stream = 1) AS streams, countIf(aborted = 1) AS cancels, countIf(aborted = 2) AS aborts FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), sess AS (SELECT session_id, argMax(model, timestamp) AS last_model, groupUniqArray(model) AS models FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY session_id), swm AS (SELECT m AS model, countIf(last_model != m) AS switches, count() AS n FROM sess ARRAY JOIN models AS m WHERE m IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY m), raw AS (SELECT s.model AS model, s.reqs, greatest(100 * s.rej_n / nullIf(s.fu, 0) - 100 * s.base_rej / nullIf(s.base_n, 0), 0) AS net_rej, 100 * w.switches / nullIf(w.n, 0) AS switch_rate, 100 * p.cancels / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS cancel_rate, 100 * p.aborts / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS abort_rate FROM sig s INNER JOIN spd p ON p.model = s.model LEFT JOIN swm w ON w.model = s.model) SELECT model AS metric, round(100 * sqrt(power(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 30, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5), 1 / 3) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - abort_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5)), 2) AS "Overall Score" FROM raw WHERE reqs >= 30 ORDER BY "Overall Score" DESC

panels.title: Scorecard (per-construct decomposition)
panels.description: Decomposition behind the Overall Score: raw user-side rates, their goalpost-standardized indices (0-1, fixed goalposts: net rejection 0-30%, switch-away 0-50%, cancels 0-5%, aborts 0-5%), PAI (Prompt Adherence) = geometric mean of the three adherence indices, Reliability, then Overall = sqrt(PAI x Reliability). Friction per 100 is shown for context but excluded from both (agent-environment construct, reported separately). Missing factors count neutral 0.5; >=30 requests required.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sig AS (SELECT model, count() AS reqs, countIf(is_followup = 1) AS fu, countIf(is_followup = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS rej_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1) AS base_n, countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1 AND signal_count > 0) AS base_rej, sum(guard_blocks + user_rejections + rule_denials) AS fric FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), spd AS (SELECT model, countIf(is_stream = 1) AS streams, countIf(aborted = 1) AS cancels, countIf(aborted = 2) AS aborts FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model), sess AS (SELECT session_id, argMax(model, timestamp) AS last_model, groupUniqArray(model) AS models FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY session_id), swm AS (SELECT m AS model, countIf(last_model != m) AS switches, count() AS n FROM sess ARRAY JOIN models AS m WHERE m IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY m), raw AS (SELECT s.model AS model, s.reqs, greatest(100 * s.rej_n / nullIf(s.fu, 0) - 100 * s.base_rej / nullIf(s.base_n, 0), 0) AS net_rej, 100 * w.switches / nullIf(w.n, 0) AS switch_rate, 100 * p.cancels / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS cancel_rate, 100 * p.aborts / nullIf(p.streams, 0) AS abort_rate, 100 * s.fric / s.reqs AS fric_rate FROM sig s INNER JOIN spd p ON p.model = s.model LEFT JOIN swm w ON w.model = s.model) SELECT model, reqs AS "Requests", round(net_rej, 2) AS "Net Rejection %", round(switch_rate, 2) AS "Switches %", round(cancel_rate, 2) AS "Cancels %", round(abort_rate, 2) AS "Aborts %", round(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 30, 0), 1), 0.5), 2) AS "n Rejection", round(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0), 1), 0.5), 2) AS "n Switches", round(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5), 2) AS "n Cancels", round(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - abort_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5), 2) AS "n Reliability", round(100 * power(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 30, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5), 1 / 3), 2) AS "Prompt Adherence (0-100)", round(100 * sqrt(power(ifNull(least(greatest(1 - net_rej / 30, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - switch_rate / 100, 0), 1), 0.5) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - cancel_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5), 1 / 3) * ifNull(least(greatest(1 - abort_rate / 5, 0), 1), 0.5)), 2) AS "Overall Score", round(fric_rate, 2) AS "Friction per 100 (context)" FROM raw WHERE reqs >= 30 ORDER BY "Overall Score" DESC

panels.title: User Rejection Rate (% of follow-up messages)
panels.description: binary mode: % of follow-up user messages containing >=1 rejection signal (profanity, frustration phrase or strong negative sentiment) - the number shown is a percentage. instances mode: weighted signal instances per follow-up message (value is per-message, ignore %). Toggle via the rejection_mode variable.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT if('${rejection_mode}' = 'instances', round(sum(signal_weight) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0), 2), round(100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 1) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0), 2)) AS rejection FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_followup = 1 AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)

panels.title: Baseline vs Reactive Rejection + Signed Net
panels.description: Reactive = signals in follow-up messages (model likely target). Baseline = first-turn signals (habitual style). Net = reactive - baseline, signed and unclamped: negative means the model draws less rejection language than the user's own baseline. Net is a heuristic, raw numbers stay authoritative.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'reactive %' AS label, round(100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 1) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING countIf(is_followup = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'baseline %' AS label, round(100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 0) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1), 0), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'net (reactive - baseline)' AS label, round(100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 1) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0) - 100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 0) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1), 0), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING countIf(is_followup = 1) >= 5 AND countIf(is_followup = 0 AND parsed = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

panels.title: Session Depth by Model (avg messages/session)
panels.description: Average turns per session from request_log; deeper continuation is an acceptance proxy. Timing windows < 100 ms are excluded (single-chunk buffered responses produce degenerate rates).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), sessions AS (SELECT model, session_id, count() AS msgs FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND model != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) GROUP BY model, session_id) SELECT model, round(avg(msgs), 2) AS "Avg Messages per Session" FROM sessions WHERE model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY model ORDER BY "Avg Messages per Session" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Signals over time (per model, normalised per bucket)
panels.description: Cancel % and provider-abort % per model per hourly bucket (% of that model's streams); rejection per rejection_mode (% or weighted instances per follow-up message). Buckets with <5 denominator messages are absent, not zero. Multiple models overlay on one chart.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, concat(model, ' cancels %') AS label, round(100 * countIf(aborted = 1) / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_stream = 1 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time, model HAVING countIf(is_stream = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, concat(model, ' provider aborts %') AS label, round(100 * countIf(aborted = 2) / nullIf(countIf(is_stream = 1), 0), 2) AS value FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_stream = 1 AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time, model HAVING countIf(is_stream = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, concat(model, ' rejection %') AS label, if('${rejection_mode}' = 'instances', round(sum(signal_weight) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0), 2), round(100 * countIf(signal_count > 0 AND is_followup = 1) / nullIf(countIf(is_followup = 1), 0), 2)) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND is_followup = 1 AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time, model HAVING countIf(is_followup = 1) >= 5 ORDER BY time, label

panels.title: Top User Rejection Strings (censored)
panels.description: Strings that triggered rejection-language detection across all messages in range; every occurrence counts. Profanity terms are censored (first/last character kept); frustration phrases shown verbatim.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT * FROM (SELECT concat(substring(term, 1, 1), '***', substring(term, length(term), 1)) AS "Rejection String", 'Profanity' AS "Category", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(profane_terms) AS term FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY term UNION ALL SELECT term AS "Rejection String", 'Frustration phrase' AS "Category", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(frustration_terms) AS term FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY term) ORDER BY "Occurrences" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Friction Rate (per 100 requests, stacked)
panels.description: Tool-action friction visible in stored conversation bodies: guard blocks (WORKSPACE-GUARD BLOCKED markers), user rejections and rule denials (opencode permission markers). Denominator: all request_signals rows of the selected models per hourly bucket (buckets with <5 rows suppressed). Counts are a LOWER BOUND: a user rejection can end the agent turn with no follow-up request, and quoting guard output can overcount slightly. Per-model detail in the scorecard.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'guard blocks' AS label, round(100 * sum(guard_blocks) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'user rejections' AS label, round(100 * sum(user_rejections) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, 'rule denials' AS label, round(100 * sum(rule_denials) / count(), 3) AS value FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top Guard Rules (ranked by blocked occurrences)
panels.description: WORKSPACE-GUARD shell-guard rule ids extracted from BLOCKED markers in stored conversation bodies (rule id = last parenthetical before the ISO timestamp). Every blocked occurrence counts; models gated to >=100 responses.

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100) SELECT rule AS "Rule", count() AS "Occurrences" FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(guard_rules) AS rule FROM llm_gateway.request_signals WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated)) GROUP BY rule ORDER BY "Occurrences" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Model-Switch Rate (mid-session escalation)
panels.description: Share of a model's hourly requests that continue an existing session but arrive from a different model (user switched to it after the previous model's turn).

targets.rawSql: WITH gated AS (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' GROUP BY model HAVING count() >= 100), switched AS (SELECT model, timestamp, if(session_id = lagInFrame(session_id) OVER w AND model != lagInFrame(model) OVER w, 1, 0) AS sw FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY session_id, timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT toStartOfHour(timestamp) AS time, concat(model, ' switches %') AS label, round(100 * sum(sw) / count(), 2) AS value FROM switched WHERE model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND model IN (SELECT model FROM gated) GROUP BY time, model HAVING count() >= 5 ORDER BY time, label
